title: The ruler on tori, by winding heights
claim: On a 6-regular torus Lambda/L with margin M (the best admissible tilt's least margin over nonzero lattice vectors; admissible tilts are the slopes in a triangle, Lemma T0): states exist exactly when M >= 0 (T1); bond distance is at least min(d, M/3) + 1 (T2); it equals d + 1 when d < M/3 (T3); the torus is read faithfully when M > 3, with nothing frozen and no tie already when M >= 3 (T4). The same on every Klein bottle whose glide keeps the forward steps (an edge glide; Lemma K0: exactly those whose pairs can be directed so that every knot is a directed cycle), with M over the whole deck group (Theorem K). Klein bottles with an altitude glide are not claimed.
failure_conditions: A torus or edge-glide Klein bottle and a pair at distance d < M/3 with bond distance other than d + 1.
A torus or edge-glide Klein bottle with M > 3 not read faithfully.
A torus or edge-glide Klein bottle whose having states disagrees with M >= 0.
foundation_claim_scope: 6-regular triangulated tori and edge-glide Klein bottles with NAE on every knot (each co-knotted pair in exactly two knots, each link one ring of six); finite worlds, no source label needed. Altitude-glide Klein bottles and every world with other knot counts are outside it.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-11; read by two independent referees (fresh Claude agents given the proof, the code and the plane proof, each with its own brute force): the first found T1 to T4 fully proved and the check's margin wrong on 234 tori (fixed) and the pre-registration's Klein note half right; the second found Lemma K1 and Theorem K proved with small fixes, matched check.py's margins on all 1,845 edge-glide presentations to 80, and tested T3 at distance 3 on three Klein bottles with M = 12.
validation.status: proved by hand; finite checks C1 to C11 in check.py passed (result.json, third run, exact margins); refereed twice, fixes made
validation.novelty: known-with-delta: quasi-periodic heights with a slope and the extension of height functions by difference constraints are known; the margin invariant and T1 to T4 and Theorem K as statements on the minimal non-shattered sets were not found in a bounded search; folklore risk moderate.
